messages:
Alex: Heads-up — the eu-west fleet had two spot preempts around 17:42 and we saw admission rejects spike to ~8%. Queue depth and p99 jumped. Looks like shard-5 lost multiple prewarmed GPUs.
Priya: Do we have the logs/metrics? which signals failed first — headroom or capacity? did warm-pool drain fully?
Alex: From metrics: headroom_shard-5=0, queue_depth_shard-5=48, admit_reject_rate=0.082. Traffic shift from region-proxy failover seemed to concentrate on a few shards.
Jamie: Thinking out loud: per-shard token-buckets + cross-shard borrowable credits, with a short cooldown when borrowed, should smooth spikes without full cluster admission collapse.
Rachel: Tradeoff: borrowing means more prewarm and potential cost. We need a hard cap and model-aware prewarm (big models = bad packing).
Priya: Proposal: predictive ramp for shards with >20% traffic delta over 1m. Prewarm up to 1.5x capacity for a 120s window, cost-capped per-customer. Also add hedged probes when new nodes come up.
Alex: Hedged probes + shallow warmup probe sounds good — reduces p99 while full KV cache fills. Also need to avoid aggressive warmdown during churn.
infra-bot: Note: autoscaler-alert: eu-west preempt events detected (2) — rolling reconcile triggered.
Jamie: Config idea: token-bucket per-shard, refill tuned to baseline QPS, cross_shard_borrow_pct=0.15, cooldown_sec=30. Soft floor admit to avoid 0% for low-tier customers.
Rachel: Also watch GPU memory fragmentation: for model XLarge, prewarm will buy an entire GPU slot effectively — treat prewarm multiplier by model memory footprint.
Priya: Canary plan: shard-aware admission smoothing + token-bucket cross-shard bleed. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100%, with hourly increments and automatic rollback on regressions.
Alex: I'll add telemetry hooks: admit_rate_by_shard, headroom_seconds, evict_count, predicted_prewarm_cost_hour. Need dashboards/alerts for p99 and queue depth.
Jamie: quick config snippet to land in the PR:
```
admission:
  per_shard:
    token_bucket_size: 500
    refill_qps: 20
    cross_shard_borrow_pct: 0.15
    cooldown_sec: 30
  predictive_prewarm:
    delta_threshold_pct: 20
    max_prewarm_multiplier: 1.5
    prewarm_duration_sec: 120
```
Priya: Add region fallback: if eu-west egress or capacity < 10% for 90s then route to eu-north fallback pool (with cost/latency tag) and surface to ops.
Rachel: SLO trigger: if p99 > 600ms and queue_depth > 40 for 3m -> auto rollback and page oncall.
deploy-bot: canary started: autoscaler-config-v2 -> 5% shards at 18:05 UTC.
Alex: Thanks team — I'll watch the canary for the next hour and post updates. :thumbsup:
